# CityClick (cityclick.com)
> Primary-Sourced US City Guides for Visiting, Moving, and Starting a Local Business

## Project Overview
CityClick publishes primary-sourced municipal guides for visitors, relocating households, and small-business founders. Every quantitative metric rendered on a certified guide is ingested directly from an official federal or state dataset with recorded source provenance and vintage. If a primary record is unavailable for a field, that UI block is omitted rather than estimated or filled with a placeholder.

## Primary Data Sources & Methodology
- Demographics, Housing & Effective Property Tax:
  - U.S. Census Bureau ACS 2023 5-Year Summary File (`B01003`, `B19013`, `B19301`, `B01002`, `B25077`, `B25064`, `B25103`; effective property tax rate = `B25103 / B25077`).
  - U.S. Census Bureau Population Estimates Program (`SUB-EST2023`, April 1, 2020 estimates base to July 1, 2023) for incorporated places.
- Small-Business Trade Establishment Density:
  - U.S. Census Bureau 2022 ZIP Code Business Patterns (`zbp22detail.zip`) paired with ACS 2023 ZCTA population (`860Z200US{zip}`) across USPS city ZIP codes:
    - `per10kResidents = (E / ZCTA_Pop) * 10000`
    - `saturationIndex = round((per10kResidents / usAvgPer10k) * 100)`
    - Classification: `< 80` underserved, `80 - 120` balanced, `> 120` saturated (`100` = US national ZBP benchmark).
  - CityClick never guesses commercial market lease rates; operators enter their own quoted lease terms in the breakeven calculator.
- Retail Sales Tax:
  - Official State Department of Revenue and Comptroller rate schedules (`sources/sales-tax.json`).
- Terrain Elevation & Climate:
  - USGS 3D Elevation Program (3DEP Point Query Service) at the Census 2023 Gazetteer municipal internal point.
  - Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (ERA5 reanalysis, 2015-2024 daily averages for July high, January low, and annual precipitation).
- Infrastructure & Civic Services:
  - Drinking Water: U.S. EPA Safe Drinking Water Information System (SDWIS active Community Water Systems).
  - Commercial Airports: OurAirports (`scheduled_service == "yes"`), straight-line Haversine distance from Census Gazetteer internal point.
  - Emergency Hospitals: CMS Care Compare (`xubh-q36u`, `emergency_services == "Yes"`, listed objectively without trauma rankings).
  - Higher Education, EV Charging & Parks: U.S. Dept. of Education College Scorecard, U.S. Dept. of Energy / NREL AFDC public EV stations, and National Park Service (NPS).

## Public REST API
- `GET https://cityclick.com/api/v1/cities/{state}/{city}`
  Open public read endpoint (no API key required) returning Census demographics, housing and effective property tax rate, combined retail sales tax, `certified` verification status, time zone, and underserved ZBP trade categories.
